title: IMDbPro Director Contact Scraper
description: Extract direct contact information from authorized IMDbPro director discovery results, processing discovery pages sequentially.

startPage.title: Start discovery page
startPage.description: IMDbPro discovery page to start from. Use this to resume after a previous run.

maxPages.title: Maximum discovery pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of discovery pages to process. Set to 0 to continue until the Actor run stops.

maxDirectors.title: Maximum director profiles
maxDirectors.description: Maximum number of director profiles to process in this run. Set to 0 for no artificial limit.
